compilation.basis: 1F: outer wall faces measured to dimension ticks for 15000x8000 overall (matches labeled 15000 and 8000mm chains). Interior partitions at x=5.0m and x=10.0m (piers, from double-line wall support scan) run full building depth. Corridor bounded by two full-width walls at y=5.0m and y=3.0m (from 3000/250/1500/250/3000 mm dimension chain), each with 3 door openings measured from wall-line gaps (pixel profile of wall colour at y=618-629 and y=804-815). West wall has a recessed vestibule/porch (approx 1m deep) at the corridor width; simplified here to a flush wall with one double-width entrance door at x=0 spanning the corridor width (y=3.25-4.75), matching the West elevation door (height evidenced 0-2.1m). South wall of the SW office has a small wall notch/chamfer (~0.3m) around its entrance; simplified to a flush wall with a single door (matches 540/900mm bottom dimension and South elevation door 0-2.1m). Windows measured from cyan hatch band extents on each facade; north/south office windows read from 2400mm-module dimension chain, corridor windows on east/west from 1200mm dimension chain.

compilation.basis: 2F: outer wall faces measured to dimension ticks for 15000x8000 overall (15000/8000mm chains). One full-height-of-band pier at x=7.48m divides the two conference rooms (north band only, not crossing corridor, per vertical wall-ink profile showing zero support between y=608 and y=793 at that x). Three piers in the south (office) band at x=3.80/7.55/11.29m divide 4 offices (south band only). Corridor bounded by two full-width walls (y=608.5px/4.996m and y=793.5px/2.993m), each wall's door gaps measured from wall-colour pixel profile. Windows measured from cyan hatch extents; north conference windows read from paired 3600mm modules (with a central mullion), south office windows and east/west corridor windows from 1200mm modules. No exterior ground-level door on this floor (upper storey; vertical circulation/stair not shown in supplied plans).
